_comment: The cross-language contract for brand-copy rendering.
src/shared/format.js and backend/internal/seo/copy.go must agree byte for
byte: the storefront substitutes these placeholders on the client, and the
server now substitutes them again when it composes meta tags for crawlers
that never run the client. Two implementations of one rule is a drift
hazard, and this file is the thing that makes the drift fail a test instead
of showing up in someone's WhatsApp preview.
Add a case here first, then make both sides pass it.

shippingCopy.name: copy that never mentions shipping is untouched, offer on
copy that never mentions shipping is untouched, offer off
the threshold is substituted while the offer stands
the only sentence is withheld once the offer is off
a promise with no terminator is still withheld
an unknown token reaches the buyer literally, offer on
an unknown token is not a shipping promise, so nothing is withheld
the seeded shipping paragraph keeps couriers and cut-off, drops the promise
shippingCopy.text: Dikirim dari Pekalongan via JNE / J&T / SiCepat. Pesanan sebelum 15.00 WIB diproses di hari yang sama. Gratis ongkir untuk belanja di atas {free_shipping_min}.
shippingCopy.want: Dikirim dari Pekalongan via JNE / J&T / SiCepat. Pesanan sebelum 15.00 WIB diproses di hari yang sama.

an unknown placeholder survives the sentence filter too
shippingCopy.text: Dikirim dari {kota_asal}. Gratis ongkir di atas {free_shipping_min}.

shippingCopy.name: a lone brace is not a placeholder
empty copy stays empty with the offer off
a question mark ends a sentence like a full stop
shippingCopy.text: Mau gratis ongkir? Belanja di atas {free_shipping_min}!

shippingCopy.name: the promise can come first
shippingCopy.text: Gratis ongkir di atas {free_shipping_min}. Dikirim dari Pekalongan.
